crossRefs.note: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within…
I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the…
holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind…
He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which…
Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did…
When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
“Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to…
During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price…
You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They…
Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get…
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

translations.web: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
translations.bsb: Then the Lord said, “Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
translations.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
translations.asv: And the Lord said unto him, Now ye the Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter; but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
